summary:
Research handoff recording the fourth confirmed in-scope violation and retiring its Surface; preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Fourth finding confirmed: direct check 495d49f163e24e3f951df60c6779ec27 executed its fixed bytes as 3d53c8e244184b0490a87411aabe15f4 with the declarative prerequisite longer-tail matched, comparison_complete and witness_complete true, and the assertion false — a log seeded through index 5 was given an accepted snapshot at index 3, compaction reported 'from=1 to=3', two entries survived, lastApplied and the snapshot index became 3, and the receiver's effective last entry stayed (5, term 1), so within_installed_snapshot was false. The blocking review issue (the snapshot protocol requires discarding a log the receiver cannot reconcile) was resolved as an independent scope boundary — whether removal by the next AppendEntries is always timely is a deployment question — rather than by weakening the claim.

Product contents: the draft map (base version 12) records the observed conditional relationship on b-install-snapshot-align and narrows its unknown, narrows the f-log-snapshot-agreement unknown to the deployment premises, and moves the installSnapshot log-tail Surface from deferred to mapped. Feedback carries the reference set and the remaining discriminators. Impact is clarification only — no meaning, identity, edge, requirement or accepted property changed, so all four confirmed findings keep their original basis.

Run state: four confirmed in-scope violations, each an implementation-level duty on an otherwise correctly explained formation, authority or support path — batching-FSM ConfigurationStore delivery (configuration entries never reach StoreConfiguration), heartbeat fast-path header gate (appendEntries reached without checkRPCHeader), TimeoutNow sender attribution (privilege granted to a sender outside the configuration), and snapshot install log-tail alignment (an unconfirmed tail retained and reported). No pending review work. Preserved as open: real-leader reachability and the window duration for the snapshot finding, no peer-level vote/election consequence measured, the ReloadConfig lease-timer lead, and the still-unread observer, snapshot-store, net_transport and processHeartbeat-concurrency areas.
